messages.businessImpact: Updates are not being delivered at all to these devices. Pauses are usually applied for a reason and forgotten once the reason passes.
remediation: Resume the ring, or record why it remains paused and set a date to review it.
messages.cannotSee: A pause is read from the ring, not from why somebody set it. A pause put on this morning for a bad update looks exactly like one forgotten a year ago, and only the second is a finding, so the ring's own history is worth a look before acting.
